"""Account a returned authentication error; optionally prepare ONE exact builtin retry."""
import copy, json, sys
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]))
from tools.common import ROOT, read_json, write_json, file_sha256, sha256, machine_id, utc_now
from tools.rolling_production_queue import no_calling
from tools.production_window_gate import inspect_window
RUN='resume-20261025-large-logical-queue-v5'
KEY='6c4245f928b296dbec8abb434b769733fc37bf280a47a480726bfc5a091dfd41'
FOLDER=ROOT/'runtime/rolling-production'
STATE=FOLDER/(RUN+'.json')
INDEX=int(sys.argv[1])
assert INDEX in (552,553)
state=read_json(STATE)
assert read_json(FOLDER/'owner.json')=={'run_id':RUN,'machine_id':machine_id()}
assert state['status']=='running'
no_calling(ROOT)
assert read_json(ROOT/'runtime/retry-scheduler/state.json')['pending'] is None
if '--guard' in sys.argv:
    assert state['next_index']==INDEX+1
    assert inspect_window(ROOT,state['after_window'],machine_id())['ready']
    print(json.dumps({'resume_existing_owner_verified':True,'state':state},ensure_ascii=True))
    raise SystemExit(0)
assert state['next_index']==INDEX
assert state['completed_source_requests']==INDEX-412
window=RUN+'-window'+str(INDEX)
stopped_path=ROOT/f'mod_nailong/data/production-window-timings/{window}-stopped.json'
stopped=read_json(stopped_path)
assert stopped['status']=='stopped_requires_reconciliation' and stopped['planned_requests']==1
resolved=[e for e in stopped['events'] if e['phase']=='image_resolved']
assert len(resolved)==1 and resolved[0]['key']==KEY
assert '401' in resolved[0]['error'] and 'token_expired' in resolved[0]['error']
assert 'moderation_blocked' not in resolved[0]['error']
plan_path=ROOT/'runtime/after128-continuous-plan.json'
plan=read_json(plan_path);item=plan['batches'][INDEX]
assert item['batch']==stopped['batches'][0]['batch']
job=read_json(ROOT/item['jobs'])[0]
history_path=ROOT/f'mod_nailong/data/generation-requests/{KEY}.json'
history=read_json(history_path);attempt=history['attempts'][-1]
assert attempt['number']==INDEX-551 and attempt['status']=='failed'
assert attempt['prompt']==job['prompt'] and 'token_expired' in attempt['error']
ledger_path=ROOT/f'runtime/production-queue/dispatch/{KEY}-{attempt["number"]:03}.json'
ledger=read_json(ledger_path)
assert ledger['status']=='tool_error' and ledger['actual_prompt_verified_before_call']
actual_path=Path(ledger['actual_request_snapshot_file'])
assert file_sha256(actual_path)==ledger['actual_request_snapshot_sha256']
assert read_json(actual_path)==job
assert file_sha256(ROOT/attempt['prompt_file'])==sha256(job['prompt'].encode('utf-8'))==attempt['prompt_sha256']==ledger['prompt_sha256']
assert [file_sha256(Path(p)) for p in job['references']]==ledger['input_sha256']
assert file_sha256(Path(ledger['actual_error_file']))==ledger['actual_error_sha256']
assert KEY not in read_json(ROOT/'mod_nailong/data/image-retry-queue.json')['sources']
assert KEY not in read_json(ROOT/'mod_nailong/data/generated.json')['portraits']
for needle in ('generation_requests.py fail','production_prepare_boundary.py --apply-reviews'):
    assert any(e['phase']=='local_command_finished' and e['exit_code']==0 and needle in e['command'].replace('\\','/') for e in stopped['events'])
now=utc_now();reconciled=window+'-auth-reconciled'
receipt_path=ROOT/f'mod_nailong/data/production-window-timings/{reconciled}-completed.json'
audit_path=ROOT/f'mod_nailong/data/production-owner-failures/20261025-v5-window{INDEX}-authentication-reconciliation.json'
assert not receipt_path.exists() and not audit_path.exists()
receipt=copy.deepcopy(stopped)
receipt.update(window_id=reconciled,status='completed',completed_at_utc=now,
    source_stopped_receipt=stopped_path.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix(),
    source_stopped_receipt_sha256=file_sha256(stopped_path),
    new_image_calls_during_reconciliation=0,
    result_classification='terminal_authentication_error_no_image',
    scope='Original failed receipt is unchanged. Completed means the actual error was durably imported, not a returned/approved image or a content refusal. One invocation is counted once; no content retry quota or cooldown is consumed.')
receipt['events'].append({'phase':'batch_imports_completed','batch':item['batch'],'observed_at_utc':now,'terminal_error_import_only':True})
write_json(receipt_path,receipt)
assert inspect_window(ROOT,reconciled,machine_id())['ready']
updated=copy.deepcopy(state)
updated.update(next_index=INDEX+1,after_window=reconciled,completed_windows=state['completed_windows']+1,
    completed_source_requests=state['completed_source_requests']+1,updated_at_utc=now,
    last_local_reconciliation=audit_path.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix())
audit={'machine_id':machine_id(),'observed_at_utc':now,'original_owner_state':state,
    'original_owner_state_sha256':file_sha256(STATE),'original_stopped_receipt':receipt['source_stopped_receipt'],
    'original_stopped_receipt_sha256':file_sha256(stopped_path),'new_reconciled_receipt':receipt_path.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix(),
    'new_reconciled_receipt_sha256':file_sha256(receipt_path),'actual_job':job,
    'actual_snapshot_sha256':file_sha256(actual_path),'ledger':ledger,'actual_error':attempt['error'],
    'owner_state_after':updated,'image_calls_in_reconciliation':0,'content_refusals_in_reconciliation':0,
    'content_cooldown_retry_counter_changes':0,'authentication_recovery_limit':1,
    'reconciliation_script_sha256':file_sha256(Path(__file__)),
    'source_code':Path(__file__).read_text(encoding='utf-8'),
    'status':'validated_state_advance_pending'}
write_json(audit_path,audit);write_json(STATE,updated)
audit.update(status='reconciled_auth_error_accounted_once',owner_state_after_sha256=file_sha256(STATE))
if INDEX==552 and '--prepare-once' in sys.argv:
    from mod_nailong.tools.generation_requests import prepare, verified_opaque_canvas_instruction
    assert len(history['attempts'])==1 and attempt['alpha_prompt_policy']=='source-manually-verified-opaque-canvas-v1'
    suffix=verified_opaque_canvas_instruction();assert job['prompt'].endswith(suffix)
    queue_sha=file_sha256(ROOT/'mod_nailong/data/image-retry-queue.json')
    fresh=prepare(KEY,job['prompt'][:-len(suffix)],False,opaque_canvas_reason=attempt['opaque_canvas_reason'])
    assert fresh==job,'Technical retry must preserve the entire tool payload exactly'
    history2=read_json(history_path);second=history2['attempts'][-1]
    assert second['number']==2 and second['inputs']==attempt['inputs']
    assert second['prompt_sha256']==attempt['prompt_sha256']
    second['authentication_retry_of_attempt']=1
    second['authentication_retry_reason']='One bounded recovery attempt in a fresh builtin tool execution context after terminal HTTP401 token_expired; unchanged full prompt, ordered input bytes and transparency flag. Not a content refusal or moderation retry.'
    second['feature_preservation_prompt_policy']=attempt['feature_preservation_prompt_policy']
    write_json(history_path,history2)
    batch='resume-low-exact-auth-recovery-20261025'
    jobs_path=ROOT/f'runtime/production-{batch}-jobs.json'
    assert not jobs_path.exists();write_json(jobs_path,[fresh])
    plan['batches'].insert(INDEX+1,{'batch':batch,'jobs':jobs_path.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix()})
    write_json(plan_path,plan)
    assert file_sha256(ROOT/'mod_nailong/data/image-retry-queue.json')==queue_sha
    audit['exact_authentication_retry_prepared']={'attempt_number':2,'batch':batch,'jobs':jobs_path.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix(),'jobs_sha256':file_sha256(jobs_path),'full_prompt_sha256':second['prompt_sha256'],'input_sha256':ledger['input_sha256'],'transparent_background':fresh['transparent'],'tool':'built-in imagegen','max_technical_retries':1,'alternate_route':False}
write_json(audit_path,audit)
print(json.dumps({'status':audit['status'],'next_index':INDEX+1,'accounted_actual_calls':updated['completed_source_requests'],'new_image_calls':0,'after_window':reconciled,'exact_retry_prepared':bool(audit.get('exact_authentication_retry_prepared'))},ensure_ascii=True))
